jupiter.conjunction: You go at things with more energy than caution, you enjoy the fight, and you recover from setbacks embarrassingly fast.
jupiter.harmonious: You act at the right moment and on the right scale, and your confidence is backed by enough follow-through to justify itself.
jupiter.square: You overcommit physically and financially, take on the large version of the task, and burn out within sight of the end.
jupiter.opposition: Somebody always eggs you on, and the risks you regret were the ones taken with an audience present.

saturn.conjunction: You push against a brake you installed yourself; the work gets done, but it is heavy and nobody credits the effort.
saturn.harmonious: Your energy is disciplined rather than showy: you work steadily, you last, and you finish what other people abandoned.
saturn.square: Anger and inhibition arrive together, so you either sit on it until it comes out badly or push through and injure something.
saturn.opposition: The obstruction is a person, and you have spent real years of your life working around somebody who would not move.

uranus.conjunction: You act on impulse and at speed, you are drawn to risk, and your accidents and your breakthroughs come from the same reflex.
uranus.harmonious: You act quickly when circumstances change, and you keep your nerve in situations that make other people freeze.
uranus.square: You explode rather than argue, and the sudden decisions you are proudest of are indistinguishable at the time from the ones you regret.
uranus.opposition: The provocation arrives from outside, and the people who set you off most reliably are the ones who most resemble you.

neptune.conjunction: Your drive comes and goes without explanation, you act on inspiration rather than intention, and direct confrontation exhausts you.
neptune.harmonious: You act in the service of something larger than yourself, and you can put real energy behind an idea nobody else can see yet.
neptune.square: You cannot locate your anger until it has already gone sideways, and your efforts leak away into things that were never going to work.
neptune.opposition: People undermine you quietly, or you allow it, and you discover too late that the situation was not what you were told.

pluto.conjunction: You have enormous force at your disposal and no small setting: you either do not engage or you go the whole way.
pluto.harmonious: You have real endurance and you hold your nerve when the stakes are high, which people notice and make use of.
pluto.square: You get into fights about control that neither side can win, and the rage underneath is older than the argument.
pluto.opposition: You meet your own force in other people, and the confrontations of your life have been the ones you could not walk away from.

ascendant.conjunction: You come across as forceful whether or not you mean to, and people either back you or brace against you on sight.
ascendant.harmonious: You act decisively and it suits you; the impression you leave is capable rather than aggressive.
ascendant.square: Your manner reads as combative before you have said anything difficult, and you spend energy correcting for that.
ascendant.opposition: You meet your own aggression in whoever turns up in your life, and open conflict is a recurring feature rather than an accident.

midheaven.conjunction: You go after your career rather than waiting for it, and you are known for drive and for the occasional scorched relationship.
midheaven.harmonious: You are effective in public and it advances you; ambition looks like competence on you rather than hunger.
midheaven.square: Your ambition keeps getting you into fights with precisely the people who were in a position to promote you.
midheaven.opposition: Your working life and your home life are in open competition for the same energy, and the home gives way first.
